## The Business Impact of Candidate Experience

Virgin Media's famous case study quantified the cost of poor candidate experience: rejected candidates who had a negative experience cancelled their subscriptions, costing the company $5.4M annually in lost revenue.

This is not an outlier. Every company with a consumer-facing brand faces similar dynamics.

### The Research

A meta-analysis of 78 studies on candidate experience reveals:

Application stage:

- 60% of candidates abandon applications that take longer than 15 minutes
- Mobile-optimized applications increase completion rates by 35%
- Personalized acknowledgment emails within 24 hours increase candidate satisfaction by 47%

Interview stage:

- Candidates who receive interview preparation materials rate the experience 2.3x higher
- Average candidate frustration threshold: 3 interview rounds / 2 weeks total process
- Video interview satisfaction varies by generation: 78% positive (Gen Z) vs. 54% (Gen X)

Decision stage:

- Offer response within 48 hours of final interview: 91% acceptance rate
- Offer response after 7+ days: 64% acceptance rate
- Personalized rejection with feedback: 3.5x more likely to reapply in the future

### The CandEx Scorecard

Measure your candidate experience across these dimensions:

| Dimension | Metric | Benchmark |
|---|---|---|
| Speed | Application-to-first-response time | <48 hours |
| Transparency | % of candidates who know their status | >90% |
| Respect | Interview start-on-time rate | >95% |
| Feedback | % receiving personalized feedback | >80% |
| Simplicity | Application completion rate | >75% |

### Building a World-Class Candidate Experience

Quick wins (implement this week):

- Auto-acknowledgment email within 1 hour of application
- Status update at every stage transition
- Calendar scheduling tool (no back-and-forth emails)

Medium-term improvements (implement this quarter):

- Interview preparation guide sent 48 hours before each stage
- Personalized rejection emails with specific feedback
- Candidate experience survey at process completion

Strategic investments (implement this year):

- CRM for talent nurturing (stay in touch with silver medalists)
- Candidate portal with real-time status visibility
- Post-hire feedback loop connecting candidate experience to employee experience

At TaaS, candidate experience is core to our model. Our operating system ensures every candidate interaction is professional, timely, and respectful.
